title: Moment Coach
subtitle: Describe what is happening and receive calm, step-by-step guidance.
greeting_detail: Tell me what's happening — I'll give you step-by-step guidance.
honesty_disclaimer: Moment Coach helps when you have time to type and read — tough evenings, behavioral flare-ups, sundowning. It does NOT replace emergency help. If you cannot put the phone down, if hands are shaking, if someone is in danger — call 911.
